ai.title: Global Fintech Fest 2026: RBI Governor says fintech has taken banking from branch to hand
ai.description: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra said fintech has fundamentally reshaped Indian finance over the past decade, taking banking from branches to citizens’ hands and making financial inclusion a lived reality for hundreds of millions of Indians. He said fintech has also reduced transaction costs and settlement times, strengthened fraud detection through artificial intelligence and improved credit delivery to MSMEs.
ai.title_cn: 2026年全球金融科技节：印度央行行长表示金融科技已将银行业从分行带到手中
ai.description_cn: 印度央行行长桑杰·马尔霍特拉（Sanjay Malhotra）表示，过去十年，金融科技从根本上重塑了印度金融业，将银行业务从分行转移到公民手中，并使金融包容性成为数亿印度人的现实。他表示，金融科技还降低了交易成本和结算时间，通过人工智能加强了欺诈检测，并改善了对中小微企业的信贷交付。
